text: What would happen to dinosaur in tornado? Would long-neck dinosaur turn into long-neck helicopter?
Maybe no, because neck isn't a flaccid, floppy shaft with head.
Dear.
Me?
Explain.
A wind push on neck from one side, make head spin one way, and body go other.
Cause leg panic or cause neck snap.
But what about small dino?
Like velociraptor.
Tornado mean, they learn to fly.
It beautiful.
But they know the land.
But what about real big dino?
That way more than house.
Like Patagotitan.
Maybe too heavy to see sky time.
Sure, but heavy not mean safe.
Tornado attack with debris.
It throw branch, rock, small dino, not so super grub,
and trampoline.
It even turn forest into thousand flying spear.
So lesson is, small dino get flight,
long dino get fold, and big dino get forest.
Tornado see all dino same as me.
It all just meet with leg.
